ryan_sales: Quick ask — Medlytics wants a 10-day POC. Goal: start with hosted smoke keys then move to Dedicated (SSO). They need strict RBAC and audit proof.

leah_se: Plan: create roles `poc_monitor` (read-only metrics), `poc_infer` (inference only). Issue ephemeral invites TTL=10d. Bind tokens to pool when Dedicated is ready.

marie_security: Requirements: KMS-backed encryption for persistent creds, audit export on demand, signed AIA before inference access, explicit PHI prohibition for POC. Hosted smoke keys allowed only for non-PHI tests with TTL <= 2h.

arjun_platform: We can provision pool `md-ptcl-01` and restrict models to `rwd-q*`. CLI invite example:
redwood invite --email dana@medlytics.com --role poc_infer --expires 2026-07-15T18:00:00Z --restrict-pool md-ptcl-01
Also support `--session-ttl` for hosted keys.

ryan_sales: Sounds good. Client prefers 2h hosted smoke then switch. Need revoke/runbook in case of compromise.

leah_se: Revoke steps: 1) revoke tokens by role filter, 2) rotate pool keys, 3) run audit export for effected emails. Small revoke snippet: 
redwood tokens list --filter "role:poc_*" --older-than 0d | xargs -r redwood tokens revoke

marie_security: Add escalation list (marie_security + arjun_platform) and KMS policy screenshot for customer if requested. Also nightly audit to detect any token >1h for hosted keys.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: gist uploaded - https://internal.gists/redwood/medlytics-poc-playbook (arjun_platform)

arjun_platform: I'll provision the pool later today and DM ryan_sales the admin invite.

ryan_sales: I will collect the signed AIA and confirm PHI restrictions. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
